example.en: Human resources managers strive to cultivate a transparent culture free of toxic office politics.
example.zh: 人力資源經理致力於營造遠離惡性辦公室政治的透明企業文化。

words.mnemonic: polit- (城市、公民) ＝ 政治運作；office politics (辦公室政治人事角力)。

example.en: Our support center guarantees that agents will reply to client inquiries within two hours.
example.zh: 我們的客服中心保證客服專員會在兩小時之內回覆客戶諮詢。

words.mnemonic: re- (回) + ply (折疊、回應) ＝ 回覆信函 (reply to an email)。

example.en: New retail tablet models will be prominently displayed on the front showroom floor.
example.zh: 新款零售平板電腦樣機將醒目地展示陳列在前側展廳展示區。

words.mnemonic: dis- (分開、向外) + play (展開、折疊) ＝ 展開供眾人觀看 ＝ 陳列、展示。

example.en: Her bilingual fluency and international marketing experience make her a perfect candidate for the post.
example.zh: 她的雙語流利程度與跨國行銷歷練使她成為該職位的最佳完美人選。

words.mnemonic: per- (澈底) + fect (做) ＝ 澈底做完做到極致 ＝ 完美的。

example.en: Quarterly operational operating expenditures were slightly lower than preliminary financial projections.
example.zh: 第三季營業營運支出略低於原先初期的財務預算預測。

words.mnemonic: slight (輕微的) + -ly (副詞尾) ＝ 稍微 (slightly higher / lower than)。

example.en: The corporate annual financial audit demonstrated a noticeable improvement in overall enterprise profitability.
example.zh: 企業年度財務查核報告顯示整體企業獲利能力呈現顯著改善。

words.mnemonic: over (涵蓋全部) + all (全部) ＝ 全面的、總體的 (overall performance)。

example.en: The pharmaceutical company intends to open three new medical research labs in Singapore.
example.zh: 這間製藥公司打算在新加坡設立三座新的醫藥研發實驗室。

words.mnemonic: in- (向內) + tend (伸展、傾向) ＝ 心之所向 ＝ 打算做某事 (intend to do)。

example.en: Software engineers conducted usability testing sessions with more than two hundred active users.
example.zh: 軟體工程師與兩百多位活躍用戶共同進行了軟體易用性測試會。

words.mnemonic: use (使用) + -er (人) ＝ 軟體或產品的使用者 (user manual / experience)。

example.en: Customer service agents are required to respond to urgent complaints within one business day.
example.zh: 客服專員被要求必須在一個工作天內回應緊急客訴問題。

words.mnemonic: re- (回) + spond (承諾、回答) ＝ 給予承諾回覆 ＝ 回應 (respond to)。

example.en: The annual corporate recognition award dinner will be hosted in the hotel grand ballroom.
example.zh: 年度企業優秀員工表揚晚宴將在飯店的大宴會廳隆重舉行。

words.mnemonic: 商務社交必備：annual dinner (年終晚宴)、business dinner (商務晚宴)。

example.en: Retail commerce historically experiences a slow sales turnaround period during early February.
example.zh: 零售商業在歷史數據上往往於二月上旬經歷一段較為遲緩的銷售淡季。

words.mnemonic: 景氣或淡季常用：slow season (淡季)、slow down (減速)。

example.en: Conducting regular preventative maintenance extends the operating lifespan of factory machinery.
example.zh: 進行定期的預防性維護檢修可有效延長廠區機械設備的使用壽命。

words.mnemonic: regul- (規則) + -ar ＝ 照規則定期的 ＝ 常規的 (regular meeting)。

example.en: The retail book company maintains physical storefronts alongside a booming e-commerce platform.
example.zh: 這家連鎖書商在蓬勃發展電子商務平台的同時，依然維持著實體門市營運。

words.mnemonic: physic (自然、身體) + -al ＝ 實體的 (physical store) 或健檢 (physical exam)。

example.en: Apart from minor cosmetic packaging flaws, all shipments fulfilled strict quality standards.
example.zh: 除了少數包裝上的輕微外觀瑕疵外，全數出貨均符合嚴格的品質標準。

words.mnemonic: a- + part (部分) ＝ 各自成一部分；片語 apart from (除了...之外)。

example.en: Flexible hybrid remote hours suit the productivity needs of our digital design team.
example.zh: 彈性的混合遠距上班工時極為適合我們數位設計團隊的產能需求。

words.mnemonic: 職場服儀：business suit (商務西裝套裝)；動詞指合適 (suit one's needs)。

example.en: All domestic corporate financial statements must strictly comply with federal tax laws.
example.zh: 所有國內企業的財務報表均必須嚴格遵守聯邦稅法規定。

words.mnemonic: 聯邦規範與稅務：federal tax (聯邦稅)、federal regulation (聯邦法規)。

example.en: The internal corporate financial audit revealed several opportunities for cost optimization.
example.zh: 企業內部財務查核結果顯示了數個可供成本優化的絕佳機會。

words.mnemonic: re- (反、回) + veal (面紗) ＝ 掀開面紗 ＝ 揭曉、揭露。

example.en: A significant percentage of quarterly corporate revenue is reinvested in research initiatives.
example.zh: 企業季度營收中有相當高的百分比被重新投入於研發計畫中。

words.mnemonic: percent (百分之...) + -age (名詞總稱) ＝ 百分比率。

example.en: Our comprehensive equipment warranty gives corporate clients complete peace of mind.
example.zh: 我們全面的設備保固服務為企業客戶帶來完全的安心保障。

words.mnemonic: 行銷與保固文案極常見搭配：peace of mind (安心、無後顧之憂)。

example.en: Customers can track the real-time delivery status of their shipments through our portal.
example.zh: 客戶可透過我們的入口網站即時追蹤其貨物的運送處理狀態。

words.mnemonic: stat- (站立、處於) ＝ 事情目前所處的狀況 ＝ 進度狀態 (project status)。

example.en: The bank invested millions into cutting-edge cybersecurity to combat financial cybercrime.
example.zh: 該銀行斥資數百萬美元建置先進網路資安系統，以打擊金融科技犯罪。

words.mnemonic: 資安防護與法規考點：cybercrime (網路犯罪)、fight crime。

example.en: The regional sales manager had to decline the invitation due to a scheduling conflict.
example.zh: 該區域業務經理因行程衝突而不得不婉拒該項邀請。

words.mnemonic: de- (向下) + clin (傾斜) ＝ 向下傾斜 ＝ 下降；禮貌婉拒邀請 (decline an offer)。

example.en: Over the past decade, our automotive manufacturing company has doubled its export volume.
example.zh: 在過去十年間，我們的汽車製造公司的出口貿易量已實現翻倍成長。

words.mnemonic: dec- (十) + -ade (名詞) ＝ 十年期間 (over the past decade)。

example.en: The technology startup plans to launch its flagship smartphone application next month.
example.zh: 這家科技新創公司計劃於下個月正式推出其旗艦智慧型手機應用程式。

words.mnemonic: 產品上市行銷核心詞：launch a product (發表產品)、product launch (產品發表會)。

example.en: Safety signs prominently warn plant technicians to wear protective eyewear at all times.
example.zh: 安全警示標誌醒目地提醒廠區技術人員必須隨時配戴護目鏡。

words.mnemonic: 名詞 warning (警報/警告通知)；warn someone about/of (提醒某人某事)。

example.en: Extensive consumer behavior market surveys helped guide the design of our new packaging.
example.zh: 廣泛的消費者行為市場調查引導了我們新包裝的設計方向。

words.mnemonic: consume (消費、消耗) + -er (人) ＝ 消費者 (consumer confidence / goods)。

example.en: A clear majority of board members voted in favor of the international joint venture.
example.zh: 大多數董事會成員投票贊成這項跨國合資合作案。

words.mnemonic: 商務表決極高頻片語：in favor of (贊成、支持)；ask a favor (請求協助)。

example.en: Hotel guests may drop off executive business garments for same-day dry cleaning service.
example.zh: 飯店房客可送交商務西裝衣物以享受當日送交取件的乾洗服務。

words.mnemonic: 飯店服務常用：dry cleaning (乾洗服務)；dry storage (乾貨常溫存放)。

example.en: We established a long-term strategic partnership with a reliable regional logistics provider.
example.zh: 我們與一家可靠的區域物流供應商建立了長期戰略合作夥伴關係。

words.mnemonic: part (部分、股份) + -ner (人) ＝ 共同持股共事的人 ＝ 夥伴 (business partner)。

example.en: Leading financial institutions tightened corporate loan qualification standards this year.
example.zh: 各大主要金融機構於今年收緊了企業貸款審核資格標準。

words.mnemonic: in- (向內) + statut- (設立) + -ion ＝ 設立的公法人組織 ＝ 金融/學術機構。

example.en: Reserved parking spots are designated specifically for carpool employees and corporate clients.
example.zh: 預留的專屬停車格位專門規劃給共乘員工與企業客戶使用。

words.mnemonic: 停車位與現場：parking spot (停車位)、on the spot (當場)。

example.en: The industrial plant installed a high-efficiency motor with superior horsepower capability.
example.zh: 該工業廠區安裝了一台具備卓越馬力效能的高效率馬達。

words.mnemonic: 工業機械規格常用複合詞：horsepower (馬力，簡寫 HP)。

example.en: Partnering with the logistics firm represents a great opportunity for our expansion.
example.zh: 與該物流公司合作為我們的業務擴張代表了一個絕佳的機會。

words.mnemonic: 商機讚許詞：great opportunity (大好機會)、great success (巨大成功)。

example.en: Potential clients can try the enterprise cloud software for thirty days free of charge.
example.zh: 潛在客戶可以免費試用這款企業級雲端軟體三十天。

words.mnemonic: 促銷活動必備動詞：try out (試用體驗)；try to do (努力做某事)。

example.en: Employees must submit an official written request before taking annual leave.
example.zh: 員工在請特休假之前必須提交正式的書面請假申請。

words.mnemonic: 多益人資必考雙重用法：動詞離開、名詞請假 (annual leave 特休、sick leave 病假)。

example.en: Please retain your package tracking number to monitor your shipment progress online.
example.zh: 請妥善保留您的包裹追蹤號碼，以便於線上查詢貨物運送進度。

words.mnemonic: 物流與客服必查：tracking number (追蹤單號)、a number of (許多)。

example.en: Both parties agreed to the amended terms and signed the commercial partnership contract.
example.zh: 雙方皆同意修改後的條款，並簽署了商務合作合約。

words.mnemonic: 多益合約與協議高頻搭配：both parties (雙方)、both A and B (兩者皆)。

example.en: Company policy allows developers to use their own personal laptops under supervision.
example.zh: 公司政策允許開發人員在受監管的前提下使用個人的筆記型電腦。

words.mnemonic: 個人設備與獨立作業常用：on one's own (獨自)、own business (自己的事業)。

example.en: The automated assembly line was paused to replace worn mechanical parts.
example.zh: 自動化組裝線暫時停機，以更換磨損的機械零件。

words.mnemonic: 製造業與工廠極高頻：spare parts (備用零件)；片語 take part in (參加)。

example.en: The sales director emphasized several key points regarding international market growth.
example.zh: 銷售總監著重強調了幾項關於國際市場增長的關鍵要點。

words.mnemonic: 會議發言摘要常用：key point (關鍵要點)、main point (主要重點)。

example.en: The hotel can accommodate 200 guests.
example.zh: 這間大宴會廳最多可容納兩百位賓客同時入座。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 想像房間把客人安排進去。

example.en: Please make sure the report is accurate.
example.zh: 編制財務報表時務必提供精準無誤的數據。

reviewWords.mnemonic: accurate = correct。

example.en: I have a dentist appointment at three.
example.zh: 請於抵達診所前先以電話完成看診預約。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 常和 make 或 confirm 搭配。

example.en: The manager is available after lunch.
example.zh: 會議室目前空著可使用。

reviewWords.mnemonic: available = ready to be used。

example.en: Employees receive health benefits.
example.zh: 新政策為全體員工帶來好處。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 想成工作帶來的好處。

example.en: Please confirm your reservation by email.
example.zh: 請致電飯店以確認您的訂房資料。

reviewWords.mnemonic: confirm = make sure。

example.en: The store is convenient for commuters.
example.zh: 線上預辦登機服務為商務差旅客戶提供了極大便利。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 和 convenience 都與方便有關。
roots: ven 來 → 湊在一起正好

example.en: Contact the sales department for details.
example.zh: 行銷部門位在三樓。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 公司裡分工的部門。

example.en: Customers receive a ten percent discount.
example.zh: 凡大量訂購辦公文具者均可享有批量折扣。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 讓價格往下掉。

example.en: Please attach the document to your email.
example.zh: 請於簽署前仔細閱讀文件。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 文件可以被 attach。
roots: -ument 名詞 → 用來教導／佐證的文件

example.en: The new policy is effective immediately.
example.zh: 新的考勤規範將於下個月初正式生效。

reviewWords.mnemonic: effective = works well。

example.en: The office purchased new equipment.
example.zh: 工廠安裝了最先進的檢驗設備。

reviewWords.mnemonic: equipment 通常不可數。

example.en: The repair estimate is two hundred dollars.
example.zh: 承包商提供了一份詳細的翻修費用估價單。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 尚未確定的數字。

example.en: Travel expenses will be reimbursed.
example.zh: 出差員工請在差旅結束後檢據申請差旅費核銷。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 常和 pay 或 cost 一起出現。
roots: pens 秤、花費 → 付出去

example.en: The sports facility opens at six.
example.zh: 工廠設施配備了最先進的安全系統。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 提供服務的場所。

example.en: The train runs frequently during rush hour.
example.zh: 這列機場接駁專車尖峰時段每十分鐘密集發車。

reviewWords.mnemonic: frequent 的副詞形式。

example.en: She handles customer complaints professionally.
example.zh: 客服團隊妥善處理了所有客訴案件。

reviewWords.mnemonic: handle a problem = 處理問題。

example.en: Please reply immediately.
example.zh: 收到客訴信函後請立即回覆。

reviewWords.mnemonic: immediately = right away。

example.en: The company plans to improve service quality.
example.zh: 我們希望提升客戶滿意度。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 常接能力或品質。

example.en: Sales increased by fifteen percent.
example.zh: 銷售額增長了百分之十五。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 可以是名詞或動詞。

example.en: We will inform you of the decision.
example.zh: 我們遺憾地通知您班機將延誤啟程。

reviewWords.mnemonic: inform someone of something。
roots: form 形成 → 使心中成形、告知

example.en: The label lists every ingredient.
example.zh: 這家餐廳堅持只選用新鮮在地的有機食材烹調料理。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 食品標籤常見單字。

example.en: The elevator is closed for maintenance.
example.zh: 本週末因進行空調系統例行維護，辦公大樓將暫停開放。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 常和 building 或 equipment 搭配。

example.en: Ask the manager for assistance.
example.zh: 專案經理審核了時程表。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 管理 team 或 department。

example.en: This method saves time and money.
example.zh: 這是一種更有效率的付款方式。

reviewWords.mnemonic: method = way of doing something。

example.en: Did you notice the change in schedule?
example.zh: 請注意這項即將發生的變更。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 可表示注意到或公告。

example.en: Applicants must obtain a permit.
example.zh: 進口外國設備前必須先向相關主管機關取得核准執照。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 比 get 更正式。

example.en: Only trained staff may operate the machine.
example.zh: 只有受過訓練的技術員才能操作這台機器。

reviewWords.mnemonic: operate a machine or company。

example.en: You need permission to enter this area.
example.zh: 員工進入伺服器機房前必須取得主管的正式許可。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 常和 ask for 搭配。

example.en: Please prepare the materials before the meeting.
example.zh: 她為會議準備了簡報資料。

reviewWords.mnemonic: prepare for + 事件。

example.zh: 公司推出了一項新產品。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 常出現在 sales 或 marketing。

example.en: The hotel provides free breakfast.
example.zh: 這家飯店提供免費早餐。

reviewWords.mnemonic: provide someone with something。
roots: vid 看 → 事先看顧、供應

example.en: The department purchased new computers.
example.zh: 請保留收據作為這筆購買的證明。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 比 buy 正式。

example.en: I recommend this restaurant to visitors.
example.zh: 我強烈推薦這款軟體以提高工作效率。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 後面接名詞或動名詞。

example.en: We received a request for more information.
example.zh: 我們收到了客戶提出的退款申請。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 正式信件常見。

example.en: The position requires two years of experience.
example.zh: 該職位需要兩年工作經驗。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 比 need 正式。

example.en: The meeting is scheduled for Monday.
example.zh: 新專案的時程表已發送給所有相關主管。

reviewWords.mnemonic: schedule for + 日期。

example.en: The shipment arrived this morning.
example.zh: 新一批零件貨物預計將於本週四清關完成並送達。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 和 delivery 有關。

example.zh: 我們在購物旺季僱用了十位臨時工作人員。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 相反是 permanent。
reviewWords.roots: tempor 時間 + -ary 形容詞 → 暫時的

example.en: The company posted a vacancy online.
example.zh: 人事部門已在官方徵才網站刊登資深會計主管的職缺。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 職缺廣告常用。

example.en: If you experience any technical difficulty during online registration, please call support.
example.zh: 如果您在線上註冊期間遇到任何技術困難，請致電支援中心。

reviewWords.mnemonic: difficult (困難的) + -y (名詞尾)；片語 have difficulty in (做...有困難)。

example.en: The marketing crew will shoot promotional video clips at the production plant.
example.zh: 行銷團隊將在生產廠區拍攝宣傳影片短片。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 拍攝廣告影片常用動詞 (shoot a video/commercial)。

example.en: The board of directors will announce the newly appointed managing director tomorrow.
example.zh: 董事會將於明天公布新任常務董事人選。

reviewWords.mnemonic: ad- (向) + nounce (宣告、報告) ＝ 向大眾宣告。

example.en: Visitors may not enter the high-security facility unless escorted by staff.
example.zh: 訪客除非有員工陪同，否則不得進入高度維安設施。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 條件連接詞，等同於 if ... not，多益文法題極高頻。

example.en: An independent accounting auditor was hired to inspect our annual ledger records.
example.zh: 公司聘請了一位獨立的會計查核員來審查我們的年度總帳紀錄。

reviewWords.mnemonic: in- (不) + de- (下) + pend (懸掛、依靠) + -ent ＝ 不倚靠他人 ＝ 獨立的。

example.en: A clear majority of voting shareholders approved the proposed corporate merger.
example.zh: 絕大多數具投票權的股東通過了提議的企業合併案。

reviewWords.mnemonic: major (較大的) + -ity (名詞尾) ＝ 大多數。

example.en: Project teams must stick strictly to the established budget guidelines and limits.
example.zh: 專案團隊必須嚴格恪遵既定的預算準則與上限限制。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 片語 stick to (堅持、遵循規定)；memory stick (記憶卡)。

example.en: Our new senior engineering consultant brings a rich background in automated logistics.
example.zh: 我們的新任資深工程顧問具備自動化物流領域的豐富資歷。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 職場常考「經驗/資源豐富」(rich in experience/features)。

example.en: The energy corporation invested heavily in offshore wind power turbine technology.
example.zh: 該能源公司在離岸風力渦輪發電機技術上進行了巨額投資。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 綠色能源考題常見：wind power (風力發電)、wind turbine (風力發電機)。

example.en: None of the defective inventory items were shipped out to retail stores.
example.zh: 瑕疵庫存品中沒有任何一件被運送至零售門市。

reviewWords.mnemonic: not one 的縮合 ＝ 沒有任何一個。

example.en: International business travelers can exchange currencies at the airport arrivals terminal.
example.zh: 跨國商務旅客可在機場入境航廈兌換各國外幣。

reviewWords.mnemonic: ex- (出、外) + change (改變) ＝ 雙方相互更換 ＝ 匯兌、換貨。

example.en: The marketing director submitted a revised quarterly advertising budget for review.
example.zh: 行銷總監提交了一份修訂後的季度廣告預算以供審查。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益商業財報極核心字彙：annual budget (年度預算)、on a budget (節省預算)。

example.en: The resort is world-famous for its luxurious beachfront accommodations and spa.
example.zh: 這座度假勝地因其奢華的濱海住宿與水療設施而舉世聞名。

reviewWords.mnemonic: fame (名氣) + -ous (充滿...的形容詞尾) ＝ 著名的。

example.en: The company wellness fair offers complimentary blood pressure screenings to all employees.
example.zh: 公司員工健康展向全體員工提供免費的血壓量測服務。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 員工健檢 (health screening) 與福利常考搭配：blood test (驗血)、blood pressure (血壓)。

example.en: All factory technicians must wear appropriate safety gear when entering the cleanroom.
example.zh: 所有廠區技術人員進入無塵室時均必須穿戴適當的安全護具。

reviewWords.mnemonic: ad- (朝向) + propri (適當、專屬) + -ate ＝ 適合該場合的。

example.en: The regional corporate branch office is situated just two blocks from the metro station.
example.zh: 該區域企業分部辦公室距離捷運站僅僅兩個街區。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 名詞指市區「街區 (two blocks away)」，動詞指「阻擋 (block access)」。

example.en: The hotel receptionist extended a warm greeting to every newly arrived guest.
example.zh: 飯店櫃檯接待員向每位新抵達的房客致上熱誠的問候。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 服務業禮貌接待用語：warm welcome (熱情歡迎)。

example.en: Warehouse clerks count physical inventory items at the close of every fiscal quarter.
example.zh: 倉儲庫存人員在每個會計季度末盤點計算實體庫存品。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益盤點必備：inventory count (盤點庫存)；片語 count on (指望、信賴)。

example.en: Emergency maintenance engineers arrived at the factory accident scene within minutes.
example.zh: 緊急維修工程師在數分鐘內便抵達了工廠事故現場。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 事故處理或影視廣告必備：on the scene (在現場)。

example.en: Our advertising agency hired an experienced copywriter to craft website marketing content.
example.zh: 我們的廣告代理商聘請了一位經驗豐富的文案專員來撰寫網站行銷內容。

reviewWords.mnemonic: write (寫) + -er (人) ＝ 撰稿人、文案創作者 (copywriter)。

example.en: The corporate communications team regularly updates digital media content on our portal.
example.zh: 企業公關團隊定期在我們的入口網站上更新數位媒體內容。

reviewWords.mnemonic: con- (共同) + ten- (保持、容納) ＝ 容納於其中的東西 ＝ 內容。

example.en: Routine equipment calibration helps prevent costly production assembly line stoppages.
example.zh: 常規的設備校準有助於防止代價高昂的產線停工事故。

reviewWords.mnemonic: pre- (預先) + vent (來) ＝ 在問題來之前先擋下 ＝ 預防。

example.en: Guests are strongly advised to keep personal valuables inside their hotel room safe.
example.zh: 強烈建議房客將個人貴重物品妥善存放於飯店客房保險箱內。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 形容詞指安全的，名詞指「客房保險箱」(in-room safe)。

example.en: We cordially invite all regional business partners to attend our annual product showcase.
example.zh: 我們誠摯地邀請所有區域商業夥伴出席我們的年度產品發表會。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 名詞 invitation (邀請函)，多益商務社交極常見動詞。

example.en: Our strategic marketing mix includes targeted digital advertising and sponsored industry events.
example.zh: 我們的行銷組合策略涵蓋了精準數位廣告投放與贊助行業盛會。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 行銷核心名詞搭配：marketing mix (行銷組合)、product mix (產品線組合)。

example.en: Clear accountability is an essential element of modern corporate governance standards.
example.zh: 清晰的權責劃分是現代企業治理標準不可或缺的核心要素。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 重要構成要素：key element (關鍵要素)、essential element (不可或缺的要素)。

example.en: Please ensure that your billing address details are entirely correct before checkout.
example.zh: 結帳之前請務必確認您的帳單地址資料完全正確無誤。

reviewWords.mnemonic: cor- (共同、完全) + rect (正、直) ＝ 完全端正 ＝ 正確的。

example.en: The corporate employee benefits package includes full comprehensive medical and dental insurance.
example.zh: 該企業員工福利方案涵蓋了全面的醫療與牙科保險保障。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 福利制度考點：medical insurance (醫療保險)、medical leave (病假)。

example.en: Only pre-registered trade attendees will be admitted to the exhibition hall today.
example.zh: 今天只有事先完成報名的商務人士方能獲准進入展覽大廳。

reviewWords.mnemonic: ad- (向) + mit (送、放行) ＝ 放行進入或承認。

example.en: Our discount airfare policy promises to beat any competitor price by ten percent.
example.zh: 我們的折扣機票保證比任何競爭對手的價格再優惠百分之十。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商業競爭常見：beat the competition (擊敗競爭對手)、beat the deadline (趕在期限前)。

example.en: The client requested a follow-up telephone consultation to review the proposal terms.
example.zh: 客戶要求安排後續電話諮詢，以審視企劃書各項條款。

reviewWords.mnemonic: tele- (遠距離) + phone (聲音) ＝ 電話溝通。

example.en: Please print a hard copy of the final audit report for today's executive review.
example.zh: 請為今天的主管審核會議列印一份最終審計報告的紙本副本。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 辦公室必備：hard copy (紙本列印)、make a copy (影印)。

example.en: Handling such sensitive financial data requires strict compliance with privacy standards.
example.zh: 處理如此敏感的財務資料必須嚴格遵守隱私權標準。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益閱讀舉例與定義極高頻片語：such as (諸如、例如)。

example.en: According to the financial report, company sales increased by eight percent last month.
example.zh: 根據財務報告，公司銷售額上個月增長了百分之八。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 過去時間指標詞：last month (上個月)、last year (去年)；動詞意為持續。

example.en: The resort hotel offers dedicated supervision activities for guests traveling with a child.
example.zh: 該度假飯店為帶兒童出遊的旅客提供專門的託兒照料活動。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 飯店服務與員工福利常見詞：child care (托兒服務)。

example.en: The supervisor will tell the team about the upcoming revisions to the project timeline.
example.zh: 主管將向團隊說明專案時程即將做出的修訂。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務通訊句型：tell someone about something (告訴某人某事)。

example.en: We really appreciate your patience while our technical team resolves the server issue.
example.zh: 在我們的技術團隊排查伺服器問題時，我們非常感謝您的耐心等候。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益書信常用客氣加強詞：really appreciate (非常感謝)。

example.en: The committee chairman decided to call an emergency meeting to review the tender bid.
example.zh: 委員會主席決定召開緊急會議以審查投標文件。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益極高頻商業搭配：call a meeting (召開會議)、conference call (電話會議)。

example.en: All employees should submit their completed reimbursement forms before the end of the month.
example.zh: 所有員工應在月底之前提交填寫完畢的報帳請款單。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 截止期限關鍵時間詞：before the deadline (在截止日期之前)。

example.en: Our company has grown from a local enterprise into an international manufacturer.
example.zh: 我們公司已從一家在地企業成長為國際製造商。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益最核心主體：company policy (公司政策)、parent company (母公司)。

example.en: Ms. Jenkins comes highly recommended by several prestigious engineering executive directors.
example.zh: 詹金斯女士獲得數位知名工程主管的一致高度推薦。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益極高頻副詞搭配：highly recommended (高度推薦)、highly qualified (條件極佳)。

example.en: Building long-term client trust is essential for sustainable corporate wealth advisory services.
example.zh: 建立長期的客戶信賴對於永續經營企業財富顧問服務至關重要。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商業信用基礎：mutual trust (互信)、earn trust (贏得信賴)。

example.en: Guests expressed that they had a truly wonderful dining experience at the resort restaurant.
example.zh: 賓客們表示在度假村餐廳享受到了一次極為美妙出色的用餐體驗。

reviewWords.mnemonic: wonder (驚嘆) + -ful (充滿) ＝ 令人極其滿意讚嘆的。

example.en: Our logistics courier offers a convenient flat rate shipping fee for standard parcel boxes.
example.zh: 我們的快遞物流為標準包裹紙箱提供便捷的單一固定運費。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益商業財經核心搭配：flat rate (單一費率)、sales remained flat (營收持平未增減)。

example.en: Meeting the strict delivery deadline is absolutely critical to retaining this corporate client.
example.zh: 嚴格達成交貨期限對於留住這家企業重要客戶而言是絕對關鍵的。

reviewWords.mnemonic: ab- (離) + solut (鬆開、解開) ＝ 完全不受拘束 ＝ 絕對地 (absolutely necessary)。

example.en: Careful working capital management ensures steady cash flow during seasonal sales slowdowns.
example.zh: 審慎的營運資金管理確保了在淡季銷售放緩期間仍維持穩定的現金流。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益財務極高頻：cash flow (現金流)；workflow (工作流程)。

example.en: Our recruitment team booked an exhibition booth at the metropolitan job fair next month.
example.zh: 我們的招募團隊在下個月的都會就業博覽會上預訂了展覽攤位。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 名詞常考商展：job fair (就業博覽會)、trade fair (貿易展)；形容詞指公平 (fair share)。

example.en: The project supervisor requested additional funding resources to hire temporary contract workers.
example.zh: 專案主管申請了額外的預算資源以聘請臨時約聘人員。

reviewWords.mnemonic: add (增加) + -tion (名詞) + -al ＝ 附加的 (additional charge / info)。

example.en: The supermarket chain procures fresh organic vegetables directly from certified local farms.
example.zh: 該連鎖超市直接自在地獲得認證的有機農場採購新鮮生鮮蔬菜。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 採購食品原物料常用：organic farm (有機農場)、farm-to-table (產地直送餐桌)。

example.en: The fashion retailer will launch its new autumn clothing collection in flagship stores.
example.zh: 該時尚零售商將在旗艦門市發表其全新的秋季服裝系列產品。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益雙考點：new collection (新系列商品) 或 debt collection (催討應收帳款)。

example.en: Hotel guests may hang the 'Do Not Disturb' card outside on their room door handle.
example.zh: 飯店房客可將「請勿打擾」標示卡懸掛在房門把手外側。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 客房常考：hang a sign (掛上標示牌)；片語 hang up (掛斷電話)。

example.en: Customer service representatives responded quickly to resolve negative online reviews.
example.zh: 客服專員迅速做出回應以處理並解決網路上的負面評價。

reviewWords.mnemonic: neg- (否定、拒絕) + -ive ＝ 負面的 (negative feedback / review)。

example.en: The marketing department divided our consumer products into distinct premium pricing bands.
example.zh: 行銷部門將我們的消費性產品劃分入不同的優質價格區間帶。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 名詞指樂團或「價格區間帶 (price band) / 頻寬 (broadband)」。

example.en: We evaluated the relative cost advantages of local manufacturing versus offshore outsourcing.
example.zh: 我們評估了在地製造與海外委外代工兩者之間的相對成本優勢。

reviewWords.mnemonic: re- (回) + lat (帶來) + -ive ＝ 相互帶入比較的 ＝ 相對的。

example.en: Prospective overseas investors were taken on a comprehensive guided tour of the factory plant.
example.zh: 海外潛在投資人獲邀參加了一場全方位的工廠廠區專人導覽參訪。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 參訪行程常見：guided tour (專人導覽)、factory tour (廠房巡視參觀)。

example.en: Management explored alternative shipping suppliers to mitigate ongoing maritime freight delays.
example.zh: 管理階層評估了替代的航運供應商以緩解持續發生的海運延誤危機。

reviewWords.mnemonic: alter (其他、改變) + -ative ＝ 其他可選的路徑 ＝ 替代方案。

example.en: The corporate technology team deployed enterprise accounting software across all branches.
example.zh: 企業資訊科技團隊在所有分行全面佈署了企業資源會計軟體。

reviewWords.mnemonic: soft (軟) + ware (器具製品) ＝ 電腦軟體（注意不可數名詞）。

example.en: Every technician working on the electronic assembly line is issued a pair of anti-static gloves.
example.zh: 每位在電子組裝產線工作的技術員皆獲發一雙防靜電手套。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 量詞常用：a pair of (一雙/一副)；pair up with (與...搭配合作)。

example.en: The automated distribution center can ship confirmed online retail orders within twenty-four hours.
example.zh: 該自動化物流中心能在二十四小時內將確認的線上零售訂單完成出貨。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 物流核心動詞：ship an order (訂單出貨)；名詞 shipment (裝運貨物)。

example.en: A positive customer-first attitude is the most valued quality in our hospitality staff.
example.zh: 積極主動的顧客至上心態是我們飯店款待人員中最受看重的特質。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 職場考核重點：positive attitude (正向態度)、attitude towards work。

example.en: Budget airlines offer cheap domestic fares by charging extra for checked baggage.
example.zh: 廉價航空公司透過對托運行李額外收費來提供極為便宜的國內線機票。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 價格實惠 (cheap airfare)；在商務文案中常以 affordable 代替以避免廉價感。

example.en: Our digital sales revenue doubled following the nationwide promotional discount campaign.
example.zh: 在全國性促銷折扣活動推行之後，我們的數位銷售營收翻倍成長。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 業績翻倍 (revenue doubled)；飯店 double room (雙人客房)。

example.en: The final flight leg of our business journey departs from Frankfurt at eight tonight.
example.zh: 我們出差行程的最後一段航程預定於今晚八點自法蘭克福起飛。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益旅行航段特殊義：the first/last leg of the journey (旅程的第一/最後一段)。

example.en: All factory production contractors must strictly observe national environmental safety regulations.
example.zh: 所有工廠生產承包商均必須嚴格遵守國家環境保護安全法規。

reviewWords.mnemonic: ob- (朝向) + serv (守護、注意) ＝ 留心注意 ＝ 觀察或嚴格遵守規章。

example.en: Please draft a concise summary sentence to introduce the main points of the proposal.
example.zh: 請撰寫一句簡明扼要的摘要句，以引言說明企劃案的核心要點。

reviewWords.mnemonic: sent- (感覺、判斷) ＝ 表達完整判斷意義的話 ＝ 句子或司法判決。

example.en: Please print fifty copies of the executive conference agenda for our board members.
example.zh: 請為董事會成員列印五十份主管會議議程。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 辦公室硬體：laser printer (雷射印表機)、fine print (合約細則小字)。

example.en: The project development team will present a quarterly progress report to senior stakeholders.
example.zh: 專案開發團隊將向資深專案利害關係人提交季度進度報告。

reviewWords.mnemonic: pro- (向前) + gress (行走) ＝ 向前邁進 ＝ 進度、進展 (progress report)。

example.en: Transparent accounting audits reveal the underlying financial truth of company operations.
example.zh: 透明公開的會計審計能如實揭露公司日常營運背後的真實財務現況。

reviewWords.mnemonic: true (真實的) + -th (抽象名詞尾) ＝ 真理、事實真相。

example.en: Nobody was permitted inside the server room without displaying a verified authorization badge.
example.zh: 未出示經核實的授權識別證者，任何人皆不得進入伺服器主機室。

reviewWords.mnemonic: no + body (人) ＝ 沒有任何人。

example.en: Quality control inspectors will thoroughly examine every electronic circuit component for manufacturing defects.
example.zh: 品管檢驗人員將澈底檢查每個電子電路元件是否存在製造缺陷。

reviewWords.mnemonic: ex- (出) + ag- (秤量、衡量) ＝ 嚴格檢測 ＝ 檢查、檢視。

example.en: Due to company restructuring, the corporate management had to lay off sixty workers.
example.zh: 由於公司組織重整，企業管理層不得不裁減解僱六十名員工。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益人資必考片語：lay off (裁員解僱)；lay off workers (裁撤勞工)。

example.en: Upgrading automated processing equipment will greatly improve order fulfillment turnaround speed.
example.zh: 升級自動化處理設備將大幅提升訂單履行完成的周轉處理速度。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務效率核心詞：high speed (高速)、speed up (加速)。

example.en: The courier scheduled the package delivery between two and four in the afternoon.
example.zh: 快遞人員已將包裹配送時段排定在下午兩點到四點之間。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 時間與地點範圍經典介系詞：between A and B (在A與B之間)。

example.en: Please feel free to ask our customer service representative if you need any assistance.
example.zh: 如果您需要任何協助，請隨時向我們的客服專員詢問。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務書信與服務極高頻客氣片語：feel free to (請隨時/別客氣)。

example.en: The original quote was deemed too high, so the purchasing agent negotiated for a discount.
example.zh: 最初的報價被認為過高，因此採購專員進行了議價以爭取折扣。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務談判表示超出預算常用 too high / too expensive；放句尾表「也」。

example.en: The accounting division is still waiting for the client to confirm invoice details.
example.zh: 會計部門仍在等待客戶確認發票詳細資訊。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 表示進度尚在處理中：still pending (仍在審核中/尚未定案)。

example.en: Our support technicians are trained to identify and solve technical problems quickly.
example.zh: 我們的支援技術人員受過專業訓練，能夠迅速發現並解決技術問題。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 客服與維修的核心搭配：solve a problem (解決問題)、technical problem (技術故障)。

example.en: The senior research associate was asked to write a comprehensive report on market trends.
example.zh: 資深研究專員受命撰寫一份關於市場趨勢的綜合報告。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 職場公文必備動作：write a report (寫報告)、write a proposal (寫提案)。

example.en: All orders placed prior to eleven in the morning are processed on the same day.
example.zh: 所有在上午十一點前下達的訂單都會在同一天處理完畢。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 電商與出貨關鍵詞：the same day (同一天)；the same as (與...相同)。

example.en: Visitors are requested to park their cars in the designated parking lot adjacent to the hall.
example.zh: 訪客請將車輛停放在大廳旁的專用停車場內。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益職場場景考點：parking lot (停車場)；a lot of (許多)。
